captions.detailed: This 3D model features a short-travel dropper seatpost with a matte black slim outer sleeve and a sliding inner tube. Atop the seatpost is a standard bicycle saddle with a narrow nose, wider padded rear, and metallic silver support rails. The saddle is secured to the inner post by a black two-bolt clamp. The inner tube slides vertically relative to the outer sleeve, forming a prismatic joint that allows for 60 mm of height adjustment.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a short-travel dropper seatpost with a bicycle saddle. The assembly should feature a fixed outer sleeve, a sliding inner tube on a prismatic joint with 60 mm of travel, a two-bolt saddle clamp, and an ergonomically shaped black saddle with metallic support rails.
captions.factory: The code constructs the model in two main parts linked by a prismatic articulation. The base part is built using a cylinder for the outer sleeve. The sliding upper part consists of a smaller cylinder for the inner tube, a custom-extruded saddle clamp with bolt holes, curved metallic rails modeled using swept circles along a wire, and a lofted/extruded ergonomic saddle body. A prismatic joint is defined along the Z-axis with motion limits set to allow 60 mm of travel.
